# Claude Plugins

This repository contains plugins for Tomitribe's open source libraries such as tomitribe-util, crest, and jaws.

You can add them to Claude via typing

```
 /plugin
```

Tab to "Marketplace" and hit enter.  Then arrow down and select "+Add Marketplace" then enter `tomitribe/claude-plugins`
